tool_args.rationale: All paid observations have positive gain at H ≤ 0.48, far short of the target H = 24.3. Measuring near H = 20 tests the predicted sign reversal and constrains its magnitude before fitting the model.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the four-parameter dual-exponential model now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The five short-horizon rows constrain early gain but do not reliably separate the slow amplitude from the slow time constant.
Denser trajectory sampling is less directly informative about the slow reversal than a measurement near the forecast horizon.
